advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
advancements.doctor_m.obtain_time_key.de: We have the power to do whatever we want. Absolute control over every particle in the universe. Absolute control over everything that ever existed and everything that ever will. From now on, are you listening to me, Romana? Because if you aren't, I can make you listen, for I can do anything. From this moment on, there is no free will in the entire universe. Only my will, for I possess the Key of Time!
advancement.doctor_m.not_thermos.title: This really isn't a thermos...
advancement.doctor_m.not_thermos.descrip: What are you doing?? Drinking the oxygen from the tank??
advancement.doctor_m.you_ate_this.title: You ate that thing?!
advancement.doctor_m.you_ate_this.descri: In extreme hunger, one can become incredibly strong—like you, who pried open the oxygen tank valve with bare hands, gulped down the compressed air as if it were a biscuit, swallowing the tank and all. Your stomach protested, but your will prevailed.
advancement.doctor_m.deafening.title: Deafening
advancement.doctor_m.deafening.descripti: Strike the Warden with the Sonic Screwdriver in overcharge mode!
advancement.doctor_m.scan_overload.title: How could this be...
advancement.doctor_m.scan_overload.descr: Scanned an entity that the Sonic Screwdriver finds incomprehensible
advancement.doctor_m.not_a_hallucination: You threw the TARDIS key into lava, and doing so made the TARDIS feel uneasy.
tardis.message.control.siege.confirm_pro: Press again to enable Siege Mode! (Wait 10 seconds before clicking)
entity.doctor_m.103w_evereye.dialog.stag: §f[Marian] §r§cWhy are you hitting me! That hurts!
§f[Marian] §r§cUgh... you're bullying me! I'm fighting back!
§f[Marian] §r§cStop! Do you even know who I am?
§f[Marian] §r§cThat's so mean... even my foster mother never hit me!
§f[Marian] §r§cYou're done! I'm going to graffiti all over your timeline!
§f[Marian] §r§cI'm really angry now! There will be serious consequences!
§f[Marian] §r§cI'm telling my dad! He'll erase you from history!
§f[Marian] §r§cOw! That hurts! Do you want me to turn you into a frog?!
§f[Marian] §r§cDon't you know how scary I am when I'm mad?
§f[Marian] §r§cHmph! You think I'm afraid to hit you?
§f[Marian] §r§cHit me! Hit me! Now you know you were wrong, don't you!
§f[Marian] §r§cYou forced me! I didn't want this!
§f[Marian] §r§cHmph! Got hit, did you? Serves you right!
§f[Marian] §r§cI'll lock you in a time corner and never let you out!
entity.doctor_m.103w_evereye.dialog.peac: §f[Marian] §r§7Heh, want a full subsystem? Or an engine? I've got plenty of Nether Stars too...
§f[Marian] §r§7My stuff is expensive. If you can't afford it, don't touch me.
§f[Marian] §r§7What are you staring at? Buy or leave.
§f[Marian] §r§7I'm in a good mood today, so I'll give you a... uh, 1% off.
§f[Marian] §r§7These are treasures I've gathered from various timelines—you're getting a bargain.
entity.doctor_m.103w_evereye.dialog.angr: §f[Marian] §r§cI'm very angry right now. I don't want to talk to you!
§f[Marian] §r§cHmph! You hit me just now and now you want to trade? Dream on!
§f[Marian] §r§cGo away! You annoy me just by standing there!
§f[Marian] §r§cMy shop is closed to you today! And tomorrow too!
entity.doctor_m.103w_evereye.dialog.hurt: §c§oI'm going to use the De-Mat Gun to turn you into a time ghost!
entity.doctor_m.103w_evereye.retaliation: §4§o§lYou can't escape! Come here! — Marian rudely yanks you in front of her.
§4§lYou feel reality collapsing around you... your causal chain has been violently disrupted!
§5§oThe collapsing causal paradox strikes at your very existence...
§4§l§oMarian: The Time Vortex will teach you some manners.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.hurt.trader.1: §f[%s] §r§c§oOuch! How much is this going to cost me...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.def: §f[%s] §r§e§oPlease stop! I don't want to be your enemy...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.tim: §f[%s] §r§e§oI-I'm just passing through... please don't hurt me...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.tra: §f[%s] §r§c§oHey! The customer is king, but even a king shouldn't hit a merchant!
§f[%s] §r§c§oStop! If you break my stuff, how can I do business?
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.ceasefire.bra: §f[%s] §r§6§oAre you sure you want to do this?
§f[%s] §r§6§oI'd advise you to think twice—this is not wise.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.warn.timid.0: §f[%s] §r§cI-I don't want to... but don't push me!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.warn.timid.1: §f[%s] §r§cP-please stop! I don't want to hurt anyone, but I will defend myself...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.warn.trader.0: §f[%s] §r§cYou should know—the Time Vortex is not a pleasant place!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.retaliate.ene: §b§o%s fires a beam of light at you!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.retaliate.hig: §d§o%s flings you high into the air...
§d§o%s sends you flying into the sky!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.retaliate.vor: §4§l%s throws you into the Time Vortex!
§4§l%s feeds you to the Time Vortex!
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.welcome.0: §f[%s] §r§7What do you want? I've got Zeiton energy, Artron crystals...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.welcome.2: §f[%s] §r§7I've got plenty of good stuff here. Do you have enough energy units?
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.welcome.3: §f[%s] §r§7Welcome! The timeline fluctuations are a bit wild today—getting stock wasn't easy.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.timi: §e§o%s looks at you nervously, seemingly ready to flee...
§e§o%s shrinks her shoulders and mutters something quietly...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.aggr: §c§o%s narrows her eyes, her hand already on her weapon...
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.defe: §7§o%s steps back slightly, maintaining a polite distance.
§7§o%s doesn't come closer, but shows no hostility either.
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.interact.brav: §6§o%s crosses her arms and looks at you with interest.
§6§o%s smiles slightly: "Want to talk? I'm listening."
entity.doctor_m.103_tardis.trade.hint.su: §8§o(Subsystems? That depends on luck—not always in stock.)
doctor_m.dialog.common.trade.no_item: §7§oYour hands are empty—what are you going to buy with?
doctor_m.dialog.common.trade.reject: §c§oWhat you're holding won't get you anything here.
doctor_m.dialog.common.trade.hint.sneak: §7§oHold the required amount and §e§lSneak + Right-click§r§7 to confirm the trade.

message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: §7No Time Lord president has ever obtained the Key of Rassilon except Rassilon himself...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bOwner of the Time Key, your authority does not end here. You will not be troubled by something as trivial as death. The Hexad God is still watching over you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: §7A crystal that may have countless origins*Rassilon once possessed it, or perhaps its creator*Now, you have obtained it, and the universe shall bow to you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.detail: With it, the power under grace will elevate you above the Guardians of Time*When you 'die', you will be revived and instantly kill all enemies within 35 blocks. *Attacks will deal bonus percentage damage based on your attack damage. *Any damage that can affect you is capped at 15% of your max health, and arrows will be erased by your power*Every second you will heal for 10% of your max health and extinguish any fire on you*You gain the ability to fly, and become immune to fire, oxygen deprivation, potion effects, and echo shockwave damage.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: §7A pocket watch... It looks ordinary. Maybe.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.detail: §7When the player takes fatal damage, force revive the player and deal 25 damage to all mobs within 10 blocks.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dYour journey is not yet over. The Hexad God watches you, awaiting where your path will finally lead...
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.cooldown: §cThe pocket watch cannot protect you forever. You must wait for it to recover...* Time remaining: %d min %d sec
message.doctor_m.relic_gem: §7As time passes, her power is no longer what it once was, but may she still bless you...
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.detail: §7While equipped, you gain permanent resistance and a life-saving effect upon death.
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.status.cooldo: §bCurrent Level %d/%d §2| Resistance Level %d §c| Cooldown %d min %d sec
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.status.upgrad: §bCurrent Level %d/%d §2| Resistance Level %d §e| Upgrade Cost: %d XP §7(Right-click)
message.doctor_m.relic_gem.not_enough_xp: §cNeed %d experience levels to unlock more power
message.doctor_m.eternal_crystal.desc: §7Once blessed by Him, the divine power has waned over time, but what remains is still enough to make all life tremble in fear.
message.doctor_m.eternal_crystal.detail: §7While equipped, each of your attacks will deal an additional forced 50% damage based on your attack damage. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
message.doctor_m.tlipoca_scythe.tip: §7An apprentice reaper's scythe. Even so, it can still reap souls.
message.doctor_m.tlipoca_scythe.detail: §dThe slash of the apprentice reaper's scythe can steal the souls of all living beings.
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.detail: §7All targets hit by the De-Mat Gun will be completely erased from the timeline* They will lose all information and items of their existence and die.
